How to Set These Wallpapers Manually on iPhone and Android

All the wallpapers above are shared in 4K or original resolution, so they work perfectly on modern  phones with tall displays, from the classic 16:9 era up to 20:9 panels and foldables with an inner screen. To save a wallpaper on your  phone first, download the ZIP file of the set you like, extract it with any file manager, and keep the images in a folder you can find easily. Now follow the steps for your device.

On iPhone

  1. Open Settings and tap Wallpaper.
  2. Tap Add New Wallpaper, then choose Photos from the top.
  3. Pick the wallpaper you extracted and move it to fit the screen. You can switch it between Still and Perspective here.
  4. Tap Add, and choose whether to set it on the Lock Screen, the Home Screen, or both as a Wallpaper Pair.

On Android

  1. Long-press an empty area of the home screen and tap Wallpapers and style (the name varies slightly by phone brand, on Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo and Huawei phones it is the same route).
  2. Tap My wallpapers or Gallery, depending on your device.
  3. Select the downloaded wallpaper and pinch to adjust the zoom and position.
  4. Tap Set wallpaper and choose Home screen, Lock screen, or Home and lock screen.

On iPhones that support live wallpapers, hold the lock screen and press firmly, the motion version of the live sets will play. On  Android, live wallpapers are applied from the same Wallpapers and style menu under the Live wallpapers tab.
